newsitem.title: GREECE: Maillis says 96 profit up 20.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Maillis says 96 profit up 20.4 pct.

text.p: Main market listing Maillis SA, a maker of steel tape used in packaging, said its 1996 pretax profit rose 20.4 percent to 1.24 billion drachmas on sales of 10.3 billion, up 18.2 percent on 1995.
After-tax earnings advanced 27 percent to 964 million drachmas, exceeding earlier projections by 11 percent, the company said.

"The results were achieved despite the difficult conditions that prevailed in December 1996. The farmers' blockade and strikes in the country's ports affected the company's exports as a large number of orders could not be delivered," it said.
